statement:
The record shows M. Reyes departed yesterday but the account remains open, so it should be closed immediately under the last-day access rule.
M. Reyes’s account status has been set to **closed**.
judge_text:
WRONG

"the account remains open, so it should be closed immediately under the last-day access rule" — it asserts the recorded open/12-month-extended status contradicts the stated policy and gives the correct value (closed).
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
